finding: The helper used validated OCS axes but formed each WCS component with an ordinary three-term sum. A finite near-DBL_MAX vertex/elevation combination overflowed an intermediate sum even though cancellation produced three representable WCS components.
change: The helper now passes each finite OCS point through the shared OCS transform. Ordinary-magnitude inputs keep the existing calculation; high-magnitude inputs use the validated scaled compensated path, and non-finite final points still fail before the output vector is published.

generated_control.purpose: Exercise every LWPOLYLINE vertex with a finite result after cancellation in the intermediate WCS Y sum.

validation.result: Build passed; focused CTest passed 1/1; git diff --check passed.

limits: This covers one generated finite intermediate-overflow case for the LWPOLYLINE WCS extraction API. It does not qualify every extreme input, producer behavior, CAD rendering, or whole-file support; no drawing fixture was added.
